name: app-perspective-close-up-of-insights-screen-with-glass-tiles-and-serif-text
title: Extreme close-up of a lilac phone: serif Insights title, blood markers on glass tiles and a pink Upload PDF pill
whatItIs: A steep perspective close-up of a lilac phone on a peach-to-violet gradient showing a serif 'Insights' title, a Bloodwork card with three glass tiles (ApoB, LDL-C, HDL-C), a serif sentence about rechecking lipids, 7d/28d toggles, a pink Upload PDF pill and blurred lower tiles with a green 100% pill.
whatItMeans: Human and precise; big serif type and glass tiles make lab results feel gentle.
techniques: Shoot the phone in extreme perspective with depth blur.
Use serif for headings and insights.
Keep tiles frosted with status colours.

vocabulary.definition: An angled, magnified view of a device.
A coloured capsule for the main action.
